steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Odoo at http://127.0.0.1:8069/ with login 'admin' and password 'admin' (use the login form at /web/login). After signing in, navigate to the Contacts app (or Sales app > Orders > Customers) and create a new contact/company named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with the City field set to 'Benchville'. Save it. Then verify by reopening that contact record and report the exact Name and City values shown on the record.

02-create: In the Odoo Sales app, create a new quotation (Sales > Orders > Quotations > New). Set the Customer field to '{{runid}} Bench Customer' by typing the name and picking the matching option from the autocomplete dropdown (the value only counts if chosen from the dropdown). Then add exactly ONE order line: in the order lines table, pick any product from the product catalogue by typing in the product autocomplete and choosing an option from the dropdown, and set its Quantity to 3. Let the app fill in the unit price automatically. Do NOT add any other line. Save the quotation. Then report: (a) the exact product name you chose, (b) the unit price the app filled in for that line, and (c) the Untaxed Amount shown in the totals section of the quotation.

03-open: On the currently open Odoo quotation form (unsaved, title 'New', customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer'), there is a blocking 'Configure your product' dialog/modal open over the form. Dismiss that dialog (click its Cancel/Close/Discard button, or if it has a Confirm/OK button that just closes it, use that — the goal is to get rid of the modal without adding extra order lines). After the modal is gone, make sure the order lines table contains EXACTLY ONE line: product '{{02-create.product_name}}' with Quantity {{02-create.quantity}} and Unit Price {{02-create.unit_price}} — if the configurable product line ('Customizable Desk' or similar) is still present as a second line, delete that line. Then click Save and verify the record gets a real quotation number (the title changes from 'New' to something like S00001) and the status shows 'Quotation'. Report: the quotation number assigned, the product name on the single line, the unit price, and the Untaxed Amount shown in the totals.
